instruction: Parse the subject lines of the most recent five emails in Thunderbird's daily folder to extract the date portion (format: DD JAN YYYY). Create a single-column list of these extracted dates in LibreOffice Calc and save it as 'email_dates.xlsx' on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('alt', 'tab'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting date portions from subject lines of 5 most recent emails. Verified: subjects contain dates in format 'DD JAN YYYY' - 25, 27, 28, 29, 30 JAN 2024. Evaluator checks Excel contains these 5 extracted dates.
